map.录入招聘各阶段（简历筛选、面试、offer、入职）人数，计算各环节转化率与整体通: Enter the headcount at each recruitment stage (resume screening, interview, offer, onboarding) to compute the conversion rate per stage and the overall pass rate, shown as a funnel so the drop-off points are visible, helping HR assess channel quality and optimise the process.
map.招聘转化 = 各阶段/上一阶段: Recruitment conversion = each stage / the previous stage
map.各阶段转化率分析，可视化招聘漏斗与环节通过率: Conversion rate analysis by stage, with a visual recruitment funnel and per-stage pass rates
map.HR 复盘 Java 工程师岗位：简历 100 → 面试 20 → offer: HR retrospective for a Java engineer role: 100 resumes → 20 interviews → 5 offers, pinpointing the stage with the biggest loss.
map.对比不同职位漏斗，找出面试通过率低的根因（题面/薪酬/区位）。: Compare funnels across different positions to find the root cause of a low interview pass rate (questioning / pay / location).
map.向业务负责人展示从需求到入职的整体转化效率。: Show the business owner the overall conversion efficiency from request to onboarding.
map.：简历→面试率 = 20%、面试→offer 率 = 25%、总转化率 = 5%: Resume to interview rate = 20%, interview to offer rate = 25%, total conversion = 5%; the tool lists each stage so the bottleneck at the interview stage is located.
map.：内推 30 进 8 vs 猎头 20 进 6，分别算转化率，内推效率更高。: Internal referral takes 30 in and 8 out while headhunting takes 20 in and 6 out; computing the conversion rates separately shows internal referral is more efficient.

map.转化率突降先看哪段？: Which stage do I look at when the conversion rate drops suddenly?
map.先比相邻两段，找出环比跌幅最大的节点（如面试→offer），再查薪酬竞争力与面试: Compare adjacent stages first, find the node with the largest period-on-period drop (such as interview → offer), then look at pay competitiveness and interviewer consistency.
map.样本少时转化率可信吗？: Is the conversion rate trustworthy with few samples?
map.单岗位个位数样本波动大，宜按职位族或季度聚合后再下结论。: A single position with single-digit samples fluctuates a lot, so aggregate by job family or by quarter before drawing conclusions.
